Legal.imprintMetaDescription: Operator and contact details for Findelio.
Legal.imprintIntro: Findelio is a service provided by Webpixels. This page contains the legally relevant operator and contact details.
Legal.contentResponsibilityText: Jan Cabanik is responsible for Findelio’s editorial content and can be reached using the contact details above.
Legal.liabilityText: Content is prepared with care. However, Webpixels does not guarantee its accuracy, completeness, timeliness or continuous availability. Mandatory statutory liability remains unaffected.
Legal.externalLinksText: The respective operators are responsible for linked websites and information supplied by businesses. Unlawful content will be removed once we become aware of it and have reviewed it.
Legal.copyrightText: Findelio’s content and design are protected by copyright. Any use beyond statutory exceptions requires the prior consent of the respective rights holder.
Legal.privacyMetaDescription: Information about the processing of personal data by Findelio.
Legal.privacyIntro: This privacy policy explains which personal data Findelio processes, why it is processed and which rights you have. Swiss data protection law applies; where applicable, we also take the GDPR into account.
Legal.controllerText: The controller responsible for data processing in connection with Findelio is:
Legal.processedDataIntro: Depending on how you use Findelio, we process the following categories of personal data:
Legal.technicalData: Technical usage data such as IP address, time, requested page, browser and device information, and server logs. This data supports secure and stable operation.
Legal.accountData: For registration and sign-in: name, email address, account status and securely stored authentication data. Passwords are not stored in plain text.
Legal.listingData: For organisations and business listings: business, contact and address details, descriptions, industries, languages, and voluntarily uploaded media and profile information.
Legal.contactData: For the contact form: name, email address, optional telephone number, subject and message. The IP address is used briefly for rate limiting to prevent abuse.
Legal.purposesText: We process data to provide the directory, manage accounts and business listings, operate review and notification workflows, answer enquiries, prevent abuse, and maintain the security, stability and development of the service.
Legal.legalBasisText: Processing takes place to take steps before entering into and to perform a contract, based on overriding private interests in a secure and functional service, to comply with legal obligations, or with your consent where consent is required.
Legal.cookiesText: Findelio uses only technically necessary cookies for authentication and session management. We currently use no advertising, marketing or analytics cookies and do not embed a map.
Legal.recipientsText: Infrastructure and hosting providers may process data as processors to the extent necessary. We use Infomaniak Network SA in Switzerland to send email. Data is disclosed only where necessary to operate the service, where required by law, or where you initiate the disclosure. If data is processed abroad, we ensure appropriate protection under applicable data protection law.
Legal.retentionText: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for its purpose, account administration, handling an enquiry, security or statutory retention duties. Data that is no longer required is deleted or anonymised.
Legal.securityText: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures, including access controls, encrypted transmission and secured systems. Nevertheless, completely risk-free data transmission cannot be guaranteed.
Legal.rightsText: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, provision or transfer of your data, object to processing, or withdraw consent. Contact info@findelio.ch. You may also contact the competent data protection supervisory authority.
Legal.thirdPartyText: Business listings may link to third-party websites and social media services. The relevant provider’s privacy terms apply only after you open such a link. Findelio does not embed a map on the contact page.
Legal.changesText: We may update this privacy policy when features, service providers or legal requirements change. The version published on this page is the current version.
